name_en: bordism theory (exact Thom classification theorem unresolved)
canonical_claim: The repository asks for Thom's 1954 classification of smooth closed manifolds up to bordism; the exact unoriented, oriented, characteristic-number, or Pontryagin-Thom formulation must be fixed from a primary-source pinpoint before a proposition is selected.
domain_and_universes: Expected finite-dimensional smooth closed manifolds of a fixed dimension, with orientation data depending on the selected theorem; exact Lean types and universes remain open.
conclusion: Expected classification of equality of bordism classes by a complete invariant, or a Pontryagin-Thom identification; the received metadata does not choose between them.

alternate_encodings.target: unoriented bordism classified by Stiefel-Whitney numbers
oriented bordism classified by Stiefel-Whitney and Pontryagin numbers
Pontryagin-Thom identification with stable homotopy of a Thom space or spectrum
alternate_encodings.relationship: related classification mechanism, not interchangeable without a checked source map

scope_ambiguities: smooth versus PL or topological category
characteristic-number coefficient rings and integrality conventions
zero bordism class criterion versus equality of two bordism classes
excluded_degenerate_cases: Manifolds with boundary, noncompact manifolds, singular spaces, cobordisms outside the selected category, and ring-structure claims are excluded unless the primary statement explicitly requires them. THM-M-0604 separately owns bordism-ring structure.
foundation_profile: Lean 4 dependent type theory; classical choice, quotients, smooth-manifold foundations, orientations, and cohomology foundations remain to be frozen
tcb_profile: Lean kernel and repository-pinned toolchain/mathlib; exact imports and transitive dependency closure open
computation_profile: No computation, oracle, external CAS, or certificate is credited at intake
formal_system: Lean 4 + pinned mathlib, with exact module selection deferred to statement phase
source_revisions: Repository sources are content-bound in intake-receipt.json; immutable primary-source and formal-library pins remain downstream work
freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on changes to the received claim, selected primary statement, category or orientation conventions, Lean target/imports/toolchain, source pins, logical profiles, or rev-5.6 standard.
status_boundary: A planned intake only: no exact canonical proposition, Lean expression, H0 source review, M0 closure, R0 reconstruction, audit completion, or theorem completion is claimed.
